answers.question: Your resume says "Increased online sales by 300% during the summer sale". What was the 300% measured against, and what did you do for the sale?
answers.answer: It was the online sales on the sale weekend compared to a normal weekend. I didn't measure it myself, the owner told us. I wrote the email that announced the sale.

answers.question: The posting asks for these and your resume doesn't show them yet. For each, reply yes, some or no, and where you used it: SQL, VLOOKUP, written and verbal communication, Tableau.
answers.answer: SQL some, VLOOKUP yes, communication yes, Tableau no

items.detail: Intro to SQL class, wrote SELECT queries on a sample sales database for 2 assignments
used VLOOKUP at Tallgrass to match product codes to the weekly sales numbers
wrote the weekly newsletter myself and presented our survey results to the class
